title: kate-ui: bind match-bracket and word completion
summary: ctrl-6 moves to the matching bracket. ctrl-shift-6 extends to it. ctrl-space runs CompleteWord. Start after PKT-0074 is on main. Linux CI runs the test.

lane.reason: keys.rs has no GPUI type. Linux CI runs the test. Start after PKT-0074 is on main, because CompleteWord is that packet's variant.

data_contracts.schema_diff_summary: Start after PKT-0074 is on main. Command::CompleteWord is that variant. ctrl-6 returns Command::Move(Movement::ToMatch, Extend::No). ctrl-shift-6 returns the same move with Extend::Yes. shift-ctrl-6 normalizes to ctrl-shift-6. ctrl-space returns Command::CompleteWord. The modifier order stays ctrl, alt, shift, cmd. Leave the existing bindings as they are. cmd-o, cmd-n, cmd-w, and cmd-shift-s stay unbound. Leave command.rs and workspace.rs unchanged. Leave session.rs unchanged. This packet adds no popup and no GPUI type. Leave layout.rs and notice.rs unchanged. PKT-0069 owns those files. Leave paint.rs unchanged. PKT-0071 owns that file. Leave fold.rs and view.rs unchanged. PKT-0073 owns those files. Leave command.rs and workspace.rs unchanged. PKT-0074 owns those files. Branch from the current tip of main. base_sha records that tip at planning time. If main has moved, use the new tip.

regression_tests.name: keys::tests::ctrl_6_moves_to_the_match_and_ctrl_space_completes
regression_tests.asserts: This test fails on main because those bindings are absent. ctrl-6 is Move ToMatch with Extend::No. ctrl-shift-6 and shift-ctrl-6 are Move ToMatch with Extend::Yes. ctrl-space is CompleteWord. The test names Command::CompleteWord, so it waits for PKT-0074.
